lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's twenty? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 20? Nope!

lines.text: Twenty dots, in four rows of five. How many squares have all four corners on dots?
lines.caption: 20 dots, in 4 rows of 5. How many squares have all 4 corners on dots?

lines.text: Count every size, and tilted ones too!
lines.caption: Count every size, and tilted ones too!

lines.text: First, the twenty upright squares. Now hunt for tilted ones!
lines.caption: First, the 20 upright squares. Now hunt for tilted ones!

lines.text: Every two by two box hides one tilted square. Six boxes, so six more!
lines.caption: Every 2×2 box hides 1 tilted square. 6 boxes, so 6 more!

lines.text: Two three by three boxes hold two big tilted ones each. That's four more!
lines.caption: Two 3×3 boxes hold 2 big tilted ones each. That's 4 more!

lines.text: Twenty, plus six, plus four. That's thirty squares!
lines.caption: 20, plus 6, plus 4. That's 30 squares!

lines.text: Did you get thirty? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 30? Tell me below!
